answer: Because the velvet deposit is held in the vault escrow, the opal audit records each forfeiture and the cost of a failed attempt is fixed rather than optional. A farm that opens challenges speculatively across many aliases thus burns capital on every one it does not finish. Opening a challenge costs a deposit of 16 units that is returned only on a graded submission, so abandoning an attempt is a real loss. A farm of 81 pays that 103 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
